ghats.name: Raktha Kundam
ghats.description: Sacred pond where Lord Narasimha washed his blood-stained hands after slaying Hiranyakasipu, which is why its waters retain a reddish hue.

significance: The Ahobilam Temples are situated near the banks of the Bhavanashini River (also called Pavanasini River), a pristine stream flowing through the Nallamala forest hills. The area contains several sacred water bodies (Theerthams) including Bhargava Theertham, Gaja Theertham, and the sacred pond Raktha Kundam.
